negative_findings.description: Fetched https://www.giro.hu/ and read its navigation (Szolgáltatások, Társaságunk, Dokumentumok, Panaszkezelés, Karrier, Kapcsolat, Rendszer információ). No top-level 'Statisztika' or 'Forgalmi adatok' section exists on the operator's own site.
negative_findings.result_summary: GIRO does not maintain a visible, navigable statistics landing page; volume PDFs surface only as hashed /storage/ assets reachable through the document listing or search engines.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Any collection pipeline that assumes a stable statistics URL for GIRO will fail. Collection must be built on the /dokumentumok listing (and its /api/documents/{id} pattern), or fall back to MNB's statisztika portal for BKR series.

negative_findings.description: Repeated Hungarian searches for 'BKR tranzakciók száma' PDFs returned only 2021 and 2022 vintages (covering data to 2021/2022). No 2023–2026 vintage of the BKR forgalmi statisztika was located in this pass.
negative_findings.result_summary: Only stale public vintages of the GIRO-published monthly BKR transaction-count series were found via search.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The headline AFR uptake series may have been discontinued at source, moved behind the document listing, or simply not indexed. This is a hypothesis, not a verdict — a direct crawl of giro.hu/dokumentumok is required before concluding the series is dead.

negative_findings.description: The Hungarian phrase 'forgalmi adatok' is heavily polluted: searches surfaced BKK (Budapest public transport) traffic datasets on opendata.gov.hu and bkk.hu rather than payment clearing turnover.
negative_findings.result_summary: 'forgalmi adatok' alone is unusable as a query term for this cell; it must be paired with BKR/GIRO/elszámolás/tranzakciószám.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Query templates for automated discovery must disambiguate, otherwise the pipeline ingests transport traffic data as payments data.

negative_findings.description: No dedicated GIRO Zrt. press room / sajtószoba or news feed was identified in the site navigation or via search; operator-sourced figures reach the public mainly through MNB press releases and trade press interviews.
negative_findings.result_summary: GIRO has no discoverable owned media channel for statistics announcements.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Monitoring must be routed via MNB sajtóközlemények and fintech trade press rather than an operator RSS feed, which adds latency and a second-hand-attribution risk.

negative_findings.description: No public statistical API or machine-readable open-data endpoint was found for GIRO/BKR volumes; KELER offers CSV downloads but no documented API, and the ECB Data Portal is the only API-grade source touching HU clearing statistics found in this pass.
negative_findings.result_summary: Collection for this cell will be document-scraping-based, not API-based, except for ECB and MNB downloadable table sets.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Sets realistic expectations for pipeline engineering effort and refresh reliability for the highest-priority metric in HU payments.

coverage_gaps.description: Current (2023–2026) GIRO-published BKR/GIROInstant monthly volume series has not been located; only MNB's quarterly aggregates are confirmed as an alternative.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run a direct, deep crawl of https://www.giro.hu/dokumentumok including its filter parameters and /api/documents/{id} range, in both HU and EN versions, to enumerate all published statistical PDFs and establish whether the monthly series continues.

coverage_gaps.description: Peripheral HU/regional infrastructure actors were not searched in this pass: the postal payment channel (Magyar Posta / Posta Elszámoló Központ), CLS settlement exposure for HUF, TARGET2/T2 and TIPS participation by Hungarian institutions, and the ACH/instant vendor layer behind GIROInstant.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Extend the actor map with 'Magyar Posta pénzforgalom', 'CLS HUF kiegyenlítés', 'TARGET2 magyar résztvevők', 'TIPS', and vendor names, then re-run discovery.

coverage_gaps.description: No PFMI / CPMI-IOSCO disclosure framework document or system self-assessment for BKR, GIROInstant or KELER CSD/CCP was located, although systemically important FMIs are normally expected to publish one.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Search specifically for 'PFMI disclosure', 'CPMI-IOSCO közzétételi keretrendszer', 'önértékelés' on giro.hu, keler.hu and kelerkszf.hu; these documents typically contain multi-year volume and participant tables.

coverage_gaps.description: The English-language mirrors (giro.hu/en, keler.hu English site, MNB English statistics portal) were noted but not systematically mapped; equivalence between HU and EN document sets is unconfirmed.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Map HU↔EN URL equivalence for giro.hu and statisztika.mnb.hu so collection can prefer whichever locale publishes machine-readable formats.

coverage_gaps.description: All URLs in this slice are search- or fetch-derived candidates; several (notably hashed giro.hu /storage/ asset paths and accented keler.hu paths) are fragile and were not liveness-checked here.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Pass all URLs through the deterministic verification stage; treat any 403/timeout on mnb.hu or keler.hu as bot-defence rather than a dead link, and re-resolve accented KELER paths with proper percent-encoding.

brief: Hungary's payment-infrastructure operator layer is concentrated in three entities: GIRO Zrt. (BKR clearing plus the GIROInstant platform behind the AFR instant scheme and the qvik QR overlay), KELER Zrt. (CSD) and KELER KSZF/CCP — all overseen by the MNB, which is also their main statistical publisher. The operators themselves publish unevenly: GIRO has no statistics section and releases its 'BKR tranzakciók száma' series as hashed PDF assets whose current vintages could not be located in this pass, while KELER publishes daily/weekly/monthly/annual statistics including machine-readable daily CSVs. The most reliable structured series for BKR, VIBER and KELER turnover therefore sits on statisztika.mnb.hu (payment and securities settlement systems operation, plus the quarterly pénzforgalmi táblakészlet that also carries qvik adoption metrics), with the ECB Data Portal providing harmonised CCP/payment series for cross-country benchmarking. Practical collection for this cell should be document-scraping-first against giro.hu/dokumentumok and keler.hu, with MNB statistics as the authoritative fallback and MNB press releases plus Hungarian fintech trade press as the fast early-signal layer.
